title: Vikunja 0.17.0 before 2.8.0 builds the task.deleted notification and webhook payload, including related tasks, with…
description: Vikunja versions from 0.17.0 up to but not including 2.8.0 have a vulnerability where the task.deleted notification and webhook payload include related tasks with the deleting user's permissions. This payload is sent to all project subscribers without checking authorization per recipient, potentially exposing private task data to unauthorized users subscribed to the project or owning its webhook.
